children: AB InBev can meet its earnings goals over the medium term through rising sales and a higher price mix, analysts at J.P. Morgan write in a note. The world's largest brewer, maker of Bud Light and Stella Artois, is aiming for 4%-8% organic increases a year in its Ebitda, a goal it backed and detailed at an investor event this week. "We note a certain evolution in the algorithm," the analysts say, pointing to likely price rises in the group's labels ahead of average consumer-price inflation, which should support the Ebitda growth ambition. "We remain confident in AB InBev's ability to compound earnings." (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
